_doc: Cebuano gold set. FLAG rows come from a pass required to quote BOTH the English and the Cebuano, then cross-checked against how the CORPUS ITSELF uses the disputed word (panghupaw 4 cards vs singot 152; tabanog 7 kite vs 2 dragonfly; asin 551 all salt). PASS rows are cards the same pass examined and did not flag. Labels are NOT native-verified; every row with native:true needs a Cebuano speaker before it gates anything. Deliberately NOT hand-labelled from a word list -- that method was wrong on 3 of 9 controls in the Tagalog audit.

Even though it's huge, the whale shark eats only plankton and tiny fish, filtering them out of the water.

items.en: Your body releases excess thermal energy through sweat evaporation, cooling your skin down when you are hot or exercising!
